// CASE js_started_promises_collect expect=pass
export async function a(ids, load) {
  const pending = ids.map((id) => load(id));
  const out = [];
  for (const promise of pending) {
    out.push(await promise);
  }
  return out;
}
// CASE js_started_promises_try_each expect=pass
export async function b(ids, load, log) {
  const pending = ids.map(load);
  for (const promise of pending) {
    try {
      await promise;
    } catch (error) {
      log(error);
    }
  }
}
// CASE js_control_serial expect=fire
export async function c(ids, load) {
  const out = [];
  for (const id of ids) {
    out.push(await load(id));
  }
  return out;
}
// CASE end expect=pass
